amends: GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2_SPEC.json#THE_RULE.assignment, specifically the phrase 'assign defenders to distinct attackers greedily by nearest distance'
rule: APPEND. The frozen spec's text stays as written. This record fixes ONE ambiguity in how that text was operationalised in gpu_env/_core/_scripted_blue_styles.py; the implementation is unchanged by this record and already conforms to the clarification below.

two_readings.reading_1_defender_relative_priority: 'nearest distance' orders THREATS by their distance to the nearest defender -- i.e. threat priority itself depends on defender position.
two_readings.reading_2_defender_selection_only: 'nearest distance' governs which DEFENDER is picked for a threat, after threats are already ordered by V1's existing priority rule (distance to our own flag). Threat priority is unchanged from V1; only defender-to-threat matching is new.

THE_AMBIGUITY.why_it_matters: V1 selects the intruder nearest HOME, not the intruder nearest a defender. Reading 1 would change threat priority itself and could differ from V1 even with a single defender, since a lone defender is not always standing at the flag. Reading 2 cannot differ from V1 at N=2: a single defender assigned to the single highest-priority threat, under the unchanged home-distance priority rule, IS the V1 rule exactly.

THE_CLARIFICATION.verbatim: "Nearest-distance greedy assignment" refers to DEFENDER assignment after threat priority has already been established. Threats retain the V1 priority rule: ordered by distance to the defended home/flag, with the existing deterministic tie-break. For each threat in that priority order, the nearest CURRENTLY UNASSIGNED defender is selected (ties broken to the lowest defender index). This is Reading 2.
THE_CLARIFICATION.why_this_reading_is_required: it is the only reading consistent with GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2_SPEC.json's own MANDATORY_2V2_REGRESSION_GUARD, which requires V2 to be bit-identical to V1 at N=2. Reading 1 is not guaranteed to satisfy that constraint; Reading 2 is guaranteed to by construction (one defender, one threat slot, home-distance priority unchanged).
THE_CLARIFICATION.changes_no_behavior_at_N2: confirmed empirically, not merely by argument: GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2_PREFLIGHT.json measured worst |V2-V1| = 0.000e+00 across 1090 live states.

IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS: gpu_env/_core/_scripted_blue_styles.py already implements Reading 2 -- threat order comes from d_home (distance to own_flag_home, stable argsort), and defender selection comes from a second nearest-unassigned-defender pass. No code change accompanies this record; it documents the choice that was already made and fixes it against future re-reading of the spec text.
